marketMood: Geopolitical relief rally: Trump's last-minute Iran strike cancellation sends oil down 4.5% and lifts risk assets, but China's PMI contraction and a 4.75% US 10Y yield keep the mood cautious.

upcomingEvents.event: US July ISM Manufacturing PMI (10am ET) + Palantir & Vertex Q2 Earnings After Close
US-Iran Strait of Hormuz Peace Talks Begin (Washington / Oman)

topStories.headline: Trump Scraps Massive Iran Strike, Calls for Talks Today; Oil Dives 4.5%
topStories.summary: President Trump announced Sunday he called off a planned massive strike on Iran — which he described as 'the biggest attack since WWII' — after Gulf allies and Tehran urged restraint; US-Iran peace talks on Strait of Hormuz access and denuclearisation begin today, though Iran disputes Trump's claim a deal was already reached.
topStories.marketImpact: WTI crude ↓4.5% to ~$80.89; Brent ↓4.4% to ~$84.10; XOM, CVX, XLE ↓; broader risk assets ↑ on geopolitical relief

topStories.headline: OPEC+ Raises September Oil Output by 188,000 bpd, Amplifying Crude's Decline
topStories.summary: The OPEC+ group agreed to increase September production by 188,000 barrels per day, piling supply-side pressure on top of the Iran peace relief trade and pushing crude oil to five-week lows.
topStories.marketImpact: Oil double-hit from geopolitics and supply ↓; energy sector under pressure; easing inflation impulse from lower oil prices

topStories.headline: China Factory Activity Unexpectedly Contracts in July; PMI Falls to 49.2
topStories.summary: China's official July Manufacturing PMI dropped to 49.2 from 50.3 in June — the first contraction in five months — with new orders slumping to 48.5, the lowest reading since 2023, hit by tariff uncertainty and off-season production weakness.
topStories.marketImpact: Chinese equities ↓; 9988.HK, 0700.HK under pressure; commodity demand outlook dimmed; yuan softening watch

topStories.headline: BOJ Holds at 1%, Nikkei Surges 4% — Yen Settling After US-Japan Coordinated Intervention
topStories.summary: After the Bank of Japan held rates at 1% (8-1 vote) on Friday and Japan and the US jointly intervened in FX markets driving USD/JPY from ~162 to ~157, the Nikkei 225 surged 4.03% to ~64,362 as US tech earnings tailwinds overpowered yen strength headwinds for export stocks.
topStories.marketImpact: 7203.T (Toyota), 9984.T (SoftBank) watch on yen sensitivity ↓; semiconductor-related Nikkei names ↑; USD/JPY stabilising near 159–160

topStories.headline: Zhongji Innolight Falls 8% in Disappointing HKEX Debut After $6.8B Raise
topStories.summary: Optical transceiver maker Zhongji Innolight (3308.HK) slipped approximately 8% on its HKEX debut July 30, trading near HK$900 versus its HK$980 IPO price, despite raising $6.81B in Asia's second-largest IPO of 2026 — a soft debut that tests near-term appetite for AI supply chain listings in Hong Kong.
topStories.marketImpact: 3308.HK ↓; investor sentiment toward HK tech IPO pipeline dented; Hang Seng tech names under pressure ↓

topStories.headline: Shein Clears HKEX Listing Hearing, Targets September IPO at $40–50B Valuation but Posts Quarterly Loss
topStories.summary: Shein received Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing committee clearance for a September IPO targeting a $40–50B valuation — half its 2023 peak — but disclosed a Q2 quarterly loss and flagged US tariff headwinds in its pre-IPO financials, raising questions over pricing and timing.
topStories.marketImpact: HKEX IPO pipeline ↑ in volume; tariff-exposed fast fashion and e-commerce watch; competing for institutional capital with Zhongji Innolight

topStories.headline: Palantir Reports Q2 Earnings After Close Today; Stock Priced at 105x Forward PE
topStories.summary: Palantir Technologies reports Q2 2026 results tonight following Q1 revenue of $1.63B (+85% YoY); the AI government and commercial data analytics firm trades at approximately 105x forward earnings — a valuation that makes it one of the most expensively priced large-cap AI names heading into results.
topStories.marketImpact: PLTR watch after close; any guidance cut or miss risks sharp de-rating from current valuation; beat and raise needed to hold gains ↑ or ↓

topStories.headline: US 10Y Yield Near 4.75%; NFP Friday and CPI August 12 Are the Week's Critical Rate Tests
topStories.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield climbed to ~4.75% as of July 31 — near its highest since 2007 — driven by the Fed's hawkish hold with three dissenters; this week's July jobs report (August 7) and next week's CPI (August 12) will decide whether September rate-hike bets continue to build.
topStories.marketImpact: TLT, IEF ↓ on rate pressure; rate-sensitive equities (real estate, utilities) under pressure; dollar supported ↑

topStories.headline: S&P 500 Q2 Earnings Season: 85% Beat Rate, Aggregate Profits Tracking +47% YoY
topStories.summary: With roughly 300 S&P 500 companies having reported, 85% beat earnings expectations and aggregate corporate profits are tracking over 47% YoY growth — the strongest reporting cycle since 2021 — led by technology, AI infrastructure, and consumer discretionary.
topStories.marketImpact: SPY, QQQ ↑ fundamentally supported; earnings season nearly complete, macro data now the next market driver

companiesToWatch.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals

companiesToWatch.name: Toyota Motor

companiesToWatch.name: Zhongji Innolight
companiesToWatch.reason: Watching for stabilisation after its 8% debut flop; AI data center optical demand thesis intact but post-IPO price discovery ongoing.

companiesToWatch.name: Alibaba Group
companiesToWatch.reason: China's PMI surprise contraction to 49.2 flags domestic demand weakness directly relevant to Alibaba's e-commerce and cloud businesses.
